wikipediaSummary.title: Wild Honey (album)
wikipediaSummary.description: 1967 studio album by the Beach Boys
wikipediaSummary.extract: Wild Honey is the thirteenth studio album by the American rock band the Beach Boys, released on December 18, 1967, by Capitol Records. Recorded between September and November, it was the group's first foray into soul music, influenced by the R&B of Motown and Stax Records, and their second album to credit production collectively to the band. It continued the lo-fi style of Smiley Smile.
